newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp up on laggard buying, LCD hopes.
newsitem.headline: Sharp up on laggard buying, LCD hopes.

text.p: Sharp Corp shares jumped in the Thursday morning session as investors bought the laggard shares on hopes that the liquid crystal display (LCD) business will be profitable, brokers said.
At midday the shares were up 10 yen at 1,570.

"There is no question that Sharp is one of the leading firms involved in LCDs," a broker at a "big Four" brokerage said. "Other issues in the electronics and high-tech fields have been gathering investor interest and Sharp's turn has finally come around."
Electronics firms and high-technology issues led by Sony Corp and Fujitsu Ltd have been rallying recently, contributing greatly to the gains posted by the Nikkei average.
"It seems that the shares hit a floor when they fell to around 1,500 yen last month, so the correction phase is nearly finished," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
